name: Horrible Jellyfish 30
author: KSAplay
description: Neon rounded green download button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    0 0 10px 2px #33fd30,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #33fd30, text-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #33fd30, transform becomes translateY(-5px).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Horrible Jellyfish 30</title>
<style>
/* Horrible Jellyfish 30 by KSAplay — https://uiverse.io/KSAplay/horrible-jellyfish-30 */
.btn {
  padding: 0.8em 2em 0.8em 2.5em;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
  border-radius: 15px;
  color: #f6fff6;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-shadow: -2px 2px 5px #33fd30;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #bbfeb1;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    0 0 10px 2px #33fd30,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    inset 0 0 10px 2px #33fd30;
  transition: 100ms;
}

.btn:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    0 0 10px 2px #33fd30,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #33fd30;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px #33fd30;
  transform: translateY(-5px);
}

.btn:active {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    0 0 25px 2px #33fd30,
    inset 0 0 0px 1px #42f112,
    inset 0 0 30px 2px #33fd30;
  transform: translateY(1px);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">
  DOWNLOAD
</button>

</body>
</html>
